title: Santa Anastasia excavation yields giant skeletons

tellings.quote: and the bones of giants would come out of the the site and they would put them in the in the church. They found entire skeletons of giants.

plain: During a dig at the Church of Santa Anastasia on the island of Sardinia, around 1978 to 1981, the bones of giants are said to have come out of the ground, entire skeletons, which were then kept in the church. Tim Alberino, a guest who researches giant lore, passes this on from what he was told by someone connected to the site. If true, it would mean whole giant human skeletons were found and stored there.
